name: campaign-progress
title: Internal recall progress worksheet
for_each: select id,code from campaigns order by code

sections.title: Campaign totals
sections.note: Review against the official campaign scope before submission through the approved channel. This is not a filed report.

sections.title: Affected vehicles
sections.sql: select vin,coordinator,dealer,state,due_on,last_contact from case_work where campaign_id=$1 order by vin

sections.title: Recorded submissions
sections.sql: select reported_on,reference,actor,snapshot from progress_reports where campaign_id=$1 order by reported_on,id

name: dealer-handoff
title: Internal dealer handoff worksheet
for_each: select id,vin from case_work order by vin,id

sections.title: Vehicle and campaign
sections.note: No repair instructions. The authorised dealer uses the official manufacturer procedure.

sections.title: Contact history
sections.sql: select contacted_on,outcome,reference,actor from contact_attempts where case_id=$1 order by contacted_on,id

name: remedy-evidence
title: Remedy evidence and verification record
for_each: select id,vin from case_work order by vin,id

sections.title: Vehicle
sections.note: A record of supplied evidence. This document does not certify vehicle safety.
sections.sql: select campaign,vin,dealer,state from case_work where id=$1

sections.title: Evidence
sections.sql: select performed_on,evidence_ref,recorded_by,decision,verified_by,verification_ref from remedies where case_id=$1 order by created_at,id

sections.title: History
sections.sql: select action,actor,reference,created_at from activity where case_id=$1 order by created_at,id
